# Curated Character Prompt Sources

The 30 character profiles in `profiles/` were created for Teyvat WeChat from
publicly available Genshin Impact character pages, voice-line pages, and quest
dialogue references on Genshin Impact BWIKI.

- Source site: <https://wiki.biligame.com/ys>
- Source license stated by the wiki: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
- Retrieval and exact page hashes: `SOURCES.json`
- Generated profile hashes and lengths: `MANIFEST.json`

The repository does not mirror the full source pages. The generated profiles
summarize factual character information and use only short dialogue excerpts as
speech anchors. Genshin Impact and its characters belong to HoYoverse. This is
an unofficial, non-commercial fan project.
